name: AI Background Removal
postStartCommand: bash -lc 'mkdir -p checkpoints runtime dataset; nohup env PYTHONPATH=src python -m uvicorn bgremove.api:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 > /tmp/bgremove-api.log 2>&1 & sleep 3; if command -v gh >/dev/null 2>&1 && [ -n "$CODESPACE_NAME" ]; then gh codespace ports visibility 8000:public -c "$CODESPACE_NAME" || true; fi'
